parameters.query:
SELECT 
  ol.id AS outage_log_id,
  ol.location_id,
  to_char(ol.planned_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv', 'HH24:MI') AS start_time,
  to_char(ol.planned_end AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv', 'HH24:MI') AS end_time,
  l.name AS location_name,
  l.company_id,
  l.working_hours,
  ol.planned_start,
  ol.planned_end
FROM outage_logs ol
JOIN locations l ON l.id = ol.location_id
WHERE ol.is_confirmed = false
  AND ol.verification_sent = false
  AND ol.planned_start >= (CURRENT_DATE AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv')
  AND ol.planned_start < ((CURRENT_DATE + 1) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv')
  AND l.is_active = true
ORDER BY ol.planned_start ASC;

SELECT 
  u.telegram_id,
  u.full_name,
  '{{ $json.outage_log_id }}'::uuid AS outage_log_id,
  '{{ $json.location_name }}'::text AS location_name,
  '{{ $json.start_time }}'::text AS start_time,
  '{{ $json.end_time }}'::text AS end_time
FROM users u
JOIN user_company_memberships m ON m.user_id = u.id
WHERE m.company_id = '{{ $json.company_id }}'
  AND m.role IN ('owner', 'manager', 'staff')
  AND u.telegram_id IS NOT NULL;
